title: What stangent-requirement-checker returns (Phase 2c, D99, D61)
description: For each item: does it say no more than its quotes? A dispute names the words that go too far, and code checks they're in the item. For each background sentence: is it really background?

extra.description: For says-more: the item's own words, copied exactly, that its quotes don't support. For padded: the quote, copied exactly, that the item doesn't use.
